notes.title: Demo of Sound Monster Soundboard now available
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44153176/3999a03ae2a3f91a13b932743c6d1f972368f742.png

Check out the demo and try this unique soundboard... and tell your friends :)

Soundboards commonly have 2 annoying problems that Sound Monster aims to eliminate.

It’s impossible to remember more than a handful of sound hotkeys

 Sound Monster works beautifully while playing games because you don't even need to remember specific hotkeys. You can just search for sounds and play them, without ever leaving the game.  You can even set hotkeys to the sounds you find from within the game.

 It can be challenging to set it up to work with other apps

 In-App wizard makes it easy to setup Sound Monster to work with Discord and other apps and games that support VoIP.


Many other features
Check out the Store page for all the things.

notes.title: Sound Monster Released!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=rJRtkZ3niD0;full][/previewyoutube]

Get crazy creative!
 A universal sound search key, have 5 sounds or a 1000 it doesn't matter. 
 A sound device setup wizard to play "sounds through your microphone"
 Multiple sounds on a single key (tap, double tap, holding, releasing)
 Censor bleeps sound while muting your mic
 Make a super realistic Walkie Talkie with transmission start and end sounds
 Set hotkeys without even leaving the gaming
 Included sound pack with free sounds
 Add groups of sounds to a hotkey
 Automatic Push to talk key "pressed" when a sound plays
 Loop sounds
 Fade sounds in or out
 Choose whatever folder you like for you sounds, no need to organize inside Sound Monster
